title: The Deepwood Matriarch
description: POSTED: Direfang, the great she-wolf that whelped the dire packs plaguing the darkwood, dens in the deep wood and will not be taken by a lone blade. The huntsmaster's bounty is honest coin — muster a party and end her line.
location_hint: Deep in the southern darkwood, toward the lake.

objectives.desc: Slay Direfang the Matriarch with a party
